headline: HuyenBao v11.53 — Finance Overview tab + popup overlap fix
summary: FINANCE DASHBOARD + BUGFIX. New 'Overview' tab in the Finance group gives a complete financial picture: cash flow summary (income/expenses/net per year + per month), income sources table, expense items table, assets table, liabilities table — every row is clickable and navigates to the relevant tab (career/biz/social/bank/markets/assets/edu/health). A priority-sorted action-suggestion list flags concrete things to do ('idle cash — deposit to savings', 'loan costs $X/yr — repay', 'health critical — rest', etc). Also fixes the toast-over-modal bug from v11.50 (toast z-index lowered 300→150 so open modals cover the toast instead of vice versa) and the gigs popup collapsing to 1 column on mobile (now forced 2 columns + tighter row padding).
features: FIX: toast z-index lowered 300 → 150 so OPEN MODALS cover the toast. Previously a toast firing while a modal was open (e.g. gigs popup) would cover the modal content — confusing because the user clicked a modal button and wants to see the modal, not the result toast. Now the toast sits behind the modal backdrop; still visible above page content when no modal is open.

FIX: gigs popup grid forced to 2 columns on mobile (was collapsing to 1 column because minmax(180px,1fr) only fit 1 col on a ~348px modal content area). Tighter gig row padding + smaller icon + smaller fonts on mobile so all gigs fit without scrolling.
NEW: Finance Overview tab — entry tab of the Finance group (Overview → Markets → Banking → Portfolio)
NEW: Cash flow summary card — income / expenses / net per year + per month, color-coded green/red
NEW: Income sources table — salary / business / social / space / pension / bank interest, each row clickable → relevant tab
NEW: Expense items table — living / asset upkeep / tuition / loan interest / business costs / diet / kids, each row clickable
NEW: Assets table — cash / savings / stocks / items / business value, each row clickable → relevant tab
NEW: Liabilities table — loan row clickable → Banking tab to repay
NEW: Action suggestions engine — financeActions() returns priority-sorted list of {id, priority, text, link} tuples

NEW: Action cards with priority tag (red/orange/gray) + clickable → navigates to the relevant tab
NEW: engine helpers — yearExpenses(), incomeBreakdown(), expenseBreakdown(), assetBreakdown(), financeActions()
NEW: 6 tests covering the finance helpers (194 → 200 total)

NEW: i18n keys for fo.* (title, cashFlow, income, expenses, net, perYear, perMonth, incomeSources, expenseItems, assets, liabilities, netWorth, actions, noActions, priorityHigh/Medium/Low, tapHint, viewTab)
Mobile: Finance Overview tables stack to 1 column on narrow screens (was 2)
